decisions.one_liner: Compressed 12-hour RN shift: triage tasks, ace clinical mini-games, stay on schedule — or overtime / miss the critical moment.
decisions.mvp_scope: Multi-patient accelerated shift with slots, windows, chart history (past hx), panel swap on patient change, hourly check-doctor-orders (expire end of hour), thin dynamic/urgent spawn + game-time emergencies + thin deterioration, score + final outcome (tasks + satisfaction/status), one scenario pack, thin challenge gate, prioritization debrief, fiction disclaimer — CSS motion first; no auth/chaos/full acuity/class-interaction math
decisions.main_constraints: Vanilla JS ES6 modules (+ jQuery/signals or light reactive layer); no React/Ink/Twine unless approved; military game clock; panels over floating windows; no auth/friends until Later epic; declarative modular architecture (game-config + game-state actions/subscribe + task-system processors; no liveQuery task activation)
decisions.game_runtime_rationale: Core loop is concurrent clock + clinical panels + slots; custom vanilla ES6 shell already matches locked constraints. Decision doc default (Most likely). Thin in-house layer only if later pain after slots; no Phaser/Pixi/Godot/React shell without explicit approval.
decisions.product_focus_text: This RN simulator drops players into a compressed 12-hour nursing shift filled with real-world events, diverse patients, and escalating case studies. Success means triaging tasks, acing clinical mini-games, and staying on schedule; failure means clocking overtime—or worse, missing the critical moment that leads to patient injury.
decisions.markdown_renderer_rationale: Default for Help/learning MD: plugin surface for wiki links, Mermaid fences, and KaTeX math; matches locked vanilla CDN shell. marked kept only as rejected thin fallback.
decisions.ui_motion_rationale: E7.M1: CSS panel-swap + status pulse; no GSAP until CSS ceiling proven.
